Sports · World

World Cup coverage focuses on player performances and tournament events

Coverage of the FIFA World Cup and Women's T20 World Cup highlights player achievements and controversies. Lionel Messi and Kylian Mbappe are noted in a "two-horse race" for the Golden Boot. Folarin Balogun of the USMNT scored a goal against Bosnia and Herzegovina but received a red card, making him ineligible for the next match pending an appeal. In cricket, India defeated South Africa in a T20 World Cup warm-up match. Beer demand in the US is reportedly boosted by World Cup gatherings.
